items.title: A statement win in Budapest
items.summary: Pro Doubles Women at the first-ever HYROX Budapest — fast running, strong stations, one team from start to finish.
items.take: When the plan meets execution, the result takes care of itself.

items.title: Race-day ready
items.summary: Getting my glam on isn't just vanity — it's the ritual that calms the nerves before the start pen.
items.take: Find the routine that makes you feel like you, then trust it under pressure.

items.title: Make trying hard cool again
items.summary: Back in the elite 15 doubles and chasing the next benchmark — the work is the reward.
items.take: Progress isn't about perfect conditions. It's about showing up anyway.
